coordination.title: Agents & tasks
coordination.worktreeHint: A git worktree: this task's own copy of the repo on its own branch. The agent works only here.
coordination.usage.timeHint: Time the agent spent generating replies.
coordination.usage.tokensHint: Tokens used by this task's agent and its sub-agents, counted when each reply finishes.
coordination.usage.title: Usage
coordination.how.step3: When tasks are ready, Integrate test-merges them on a scratch branch, then Create PR opens a pull request. Nothing merges into main by itself.
coordination.how.step2: Open chat and tell the agent what to do. It works only inside that task's folder, so several tasks can run at once.
coordination.how.step2Title: Talk to the task in its chat.
coordination.how.step1: New task creates a branch and a separate copy of your repo (a git worktree) next to it. Your main checkout is never touched.
coordination.how.step1Title: Each task gets its own folder.
coordination.how.title: How tasks work
coordination.acknowledgeHint: You know about this conflict and want work to continue. A blocked task is released; the conflict reopens if it gets worse.
coordination.removeDependencyHint: Blocked by a dependency it no longer needs? Remove it with × and the task gets in line to start.
coordination.empty: No coordinated tasks in this repository yet. Each task gets its own branch and worktree, so agents never write into the same checkout.
coordination.detail.working: The agent is working. Stop it any time; Resume continues where it left off.
coordination.detail.draft: Not started yet. Click Start, or send a message in its chat.
coordination.detail.inLine: Starts by itself when a slot is free ({{running}} of {{max}} in use).
coordination.detail.question: The agent is waiting for your answer:
coordination.detail.agentBlocked: The agent stopped because it is blocked:
coordination.detail.stalled: The agent is waiting on its own background work (such as a review sub-agent), which Open Computer can't see. Its slot is free. Open Computer checks on it after the interval in Settings → Agents; reply in its chat to check now.
coordination.detail.noReport: The agent stopped without saying why (no check-out). Check its chat and reply.
coordination.detail.stopped: Stopped. Resume puts it back in line and continues where it left off.
coordination.detail.waitingOn: Waiting for {{tasks}} to finish. It starts by itself after that.
coordination.detail.blocked: Blocked by a conflict or check.
coordination.detail.dependencyGone: {{tasks}} was abandoned or failed, so this task can't build on it. If its work is actually finished, mark it done and this task starts. Otherwise remove that dependency below, or end this task.
coordination.detail.review: The agent says it is done. Review the changes, run the tests, then integrate.
coordination.detail.passedIntegration: Passed integration. Publish a pull request or merge it.
coordination.started: Started. It runs when a slot is free.
coordination.merge.merged: {{task}}: its work ({{branch}}) was merged into this folder before the agent started.
coordination.merge.already_included: {{task}}: its work ({{branch}}) was already in this folder.
coordination.merge.conflict: {{task}}: merging {{branch}} conflicted, so the agent was asked to merge it by hand.
coordination.merge.skipped_dirty_folder: {{task}}: this folder had changes, so {{branch}} was not merged in automatically.
coordination.merge.error: {{task}}: its work could not be merged in automatically.
coordination.startNowHint: Off: save it as a Draft and click Start when you are ready.
coordination.integrateHint: Merge reviewed tasks into a separate integration worktree and run the tests. Nothing is merged into the base branch.
coordination.integrateMessage: Reviewed tasks are merged in dependency order into a new integration branch and tested together. Task branches and the base branch are not changed, and nothing is pushed.
coordination.integrationPassed: Passed combined tests in integration run {{run}}
coordination.startFromHint: The task's branch is created from this one, and its work is integrated back into it.
coordination.sharedRepo: This folder is part of the {{repo}} repository ({{path}}). Every folder of one repository shares one task list, so agents can see each other's conflicts and dependencies. The list shows the tasks started from this folder; switch to All to see the rest. New tasks start from this folder's branch unless you pick another.
coordination.scope.allHint: Every task in the {{repo}} repository, from any of its folders
coordination.scope.noneHere: No tasks were started from this folder. {{count}} were started from other folders of this repository; switch to All to see them.
coordination.modelRequired: Choose a model to start the agent.
coordination.newTaskHint: Creates a new branch and its own folder (a git worktree) next to your repo, plus a chat whose agent works only in that folder. Your main checkout is never touched.
coordination.notRepo: This workspace is not a Git repository.
coordination.notValidated: Tests have not been run for this task.
coordination.notePlaceholder: Note for this agent's next turn…
coordination.publishMessage: This pushes {{branch}} to origin and creates or updates its pull request. It does not merge anything.
coordination.removeWorktreeHint: The branch and its commits are kept. Refused if there are uncommitted changes.
coordination.removeWorktreeMessage: Deletes the folder {{path}}. The branch and its commits are kept.
coordination.requestFixHint: Starts one agent turn with what integration found.
coordination.resolveHint: Hide it now; it reopens on the next scan if the evidence is still there.
coordination.resumeHint: Queue the task; its agent continues when a slot is free and dependencies are ready.
coordination.retryHint: Queue the failed task again. Committed work is kept.
coordination.runningHint: Tasks owning active work; 'generating' counts agents producing output right now.
coordination.selectTask: Select a task to see its worktree, conflicts and messages.
coordination.startPromptHint: Leave empty to drive the agent yourself from its chat.
coordination.diffFiles_one: {{count}} file changed. Click a file to see its lines.
coordination.diffFiles_other: {{count}} files changed. Click a file to see its lines.
coordination.waitingForUserHint: The agent finished its last turn and is waiting for you. Its slot is free for other tasks. Send a message in its chat to continue it.
coordination.waitingSlotHint: This task has instructions, so it starts by itself when an agent slot is free. {{running}} of {{max}} task agents are running in this repository. Admins can change the limit in Settings → Agents.
admin.taskAgentsAtOnceHint: For Agents & tasks: how many task agents may work at the same time in one repository. Queued tasks with instructions wait for a free slot. Default 4.
admin.taskCheckinMinutes: Check on agents waiting on background work every
admin.taskCheckinMinutesHint: An agent that checks out "continuing" while nothing Open Computer can see is running for it (for example an OpenCode reviewer sub-agent) gets one short check-in turn after this many minutes, up to 6 times in a row. It uses a timer, not polling. 0 turns it off.
coordination.chatGoneMessage: This task's chat was deleted, so no agent can work on it. Delete the task to remove it from this list. Its branch and commits are kept, and you choose whether to keep its folder.
coordination.endHint: Finish this task: mark it done, or abandon it. Either way the agent stops and its branch, worktree and chat are kept.
coordination.closeMessage: Mark done if its work is finished (even if you merged it yourself). Abandon if you're giving up on it. Either way the agent stops and its branch, worktree and chat are kept.
coordination.closeMessageDependents_one: {{tasks}} is waiting on this task. Mark done if its work is finished: {{tasks}} then starts, with this branch merged in. Abandon if you're giving up on it: {{tasks}} is then blocked until you remove the dependency.
coordination.closeMessageDependents_othe: {{count}} tasks are waiting on this one ({{tasks}}). Mark done if its work is finished: they then start, with this branch merged in. Abandon if you're giving up on it: they're blocked until you remove the dependency.
coordination.markDoneHint: Its work is finished (or landed another way, such as a PR you merged). Tasks that depend on it can start.
coordination.markDoneMessage: "{{title}}" moves to Done and its agent stops. Tasks that depend on it can start, with its branch merged into theirs. Use this when its work is finished, even if you merged it outside Open Computer.
coordination.markDepDoneHint: If that task's work is finished, mark it done and this task starts.
coordination.deleteHint: Removes it from this list. The branch and its commits are kept.
coordination.deleteMessage: The task, its conflicts and messages are removed from the dashboard. The branch {{branch}} and its commits are kept, and the chat stays as a normal chat.
coordination.deleteFolderMessage: Deletes {{path}}. The branch and its commits are kept either way. Refused if the folder has uncommitted changes.
coordination.chipTooltip: This chat is the agent for task “{{title}}”. It works only in the task's own folder (a git worktree on its own branch), not your main checkout. Click to open the task in Agents & tasks.
